in_marathi.name: Dhanishtha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Dharma's Shining Star
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhanishtha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhanishtha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'dhanishta', which means 'the one who obtains dharma'. It is a name of Lord Shiva and is believed to bring prosperity and success. The name symbolizes one who shines brightly in dharma, virtue, and righteousness.
